name: obsdog
description: Find, remember, maintain, report on, and documentify measurable knowledge in ObsDog Spaces.

interface.shortDescription: Work with measurable knowledge in five focused ways.
interface.longDescription: Five ObsDog knowledge workflows. Plugin installation does not install the CLI. First run obsdog version and install CLI v0.2.2+ from https://github.com/obsdoghq/obsdog-releases if needed. Then verify find in a fresh session. Optional global instructions: https://github.com/obsdoghq/skills/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md . No login, sync or automatic upload is enabled.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ObsDog to search my selected Personal Space and measure only what is actually opened and used.
